seoDescription: Learn how to build a complete membership website with WordPress using the powerful WooCommerce Memberships plugin. This detailed tutorial walks you through setting up tiered membership plans, restricting content and products to members-only, and offering exclusive purchasing discounts. Discover how to create different membership levels, such as Gold and Silver, establish prerequisites for higher tiers, and grant access to specific pages or product categories based on a user's membership plan.

chapters.title: Introduction to WooCommerce Memberships
chapters.description: This chapter introduces the core functionalities of the WooCommerce Memberships plugin, demonstrating content restriction, member discounts, and tiered membership examples.

chapters.title: Where to Get the WooCommerce Memberships Plugin
chapters.description: This section discusses the cost of the official WooCommerce Memberships plugin and suggests a lower-cost alternative source.

chapters.title: Plugin Dashboard & Membership Plan Overview
chapters.description: Explore the WordPress dashboard after installing the plugin, including how to find members, import/export settings, and an initial overview of an existing membership plan.

chapters.title: Deep Dive: Restricting Content, Products & Discounts
chapters.description: This chapter provides a detailed walkthrough of a membership plan's settings, focusing on how to configure content restrictions, product access rules, and purchasing discounts.

chapters.title: Creating a New Membership Plan From Scratch
chapters.description: Follow a step-by-step guide on creating a brand new membership plan, including configuring its name, access triggers, membership duration, and setting new restriction rules.

chapters.title: Creating and Configuring the Membership Product
chapters.description: Learn how to create a WooCommerce product specifically for your new membership plan, setting its price and linking it correctly in the product data section.

chapters.title: Finalizing Product Rules & Important Settings
chapters.description: This clip covers configuring custom restriction messages, linking the product to the membership plan, and highlights two critical settings: marking the product as virtual and activating discounts.

chapters.title: Testing the Purchase and Viewing the Member's Area
chapters.description: See the entire process from a customer's point of view, from purchasing the membership product to exploring the newly accessible content and member-exclusive sections in their account.

chapters.title: Final Thoughts & Conclusion
chapters.description: The video concludes with final thoughts on the plugin, highlighting the need for the WooCommerce Subscriptions extension for auto-renewals, and recommending other tutorials.

summary:
## Core Capabilities of WooCommerce Memberships
- **Restrict Content:** Make specific pages, posts, or custom post types accessible only to members of a certain plan.
- **Restrict Products:** Control who can **view** or **purchase** specific WooCommerce products or entire product categories.
- **Offer Member Discounts:** Provide store-wide or category-specific discounts (percentage or fixed amount) to members.
- **Tiered Memberships:** Create multiple membership levels (e.g., Silver, Gold) and require a lower-tier membership as a prerequisite to purchase a higher one.

## Setting Up a Membership Plan
Navigate to **WooCommerce > Memberships > Membership Plans** to create and manage your plans. Key settings include:
- **Grant Access On:** Define the trigger for membership, typically `Product Purchase`, but also `User Registration` or `Manual Assignment`.
- **Membership Length:** Can be `Unlimited`, a `Specific Length` (e.g., 30 days, 1 year), or run between `Fixed Dates`.
- **Restrict Content/Products:** Add rules to define which content or products are affected by this membership plan and when members get access (e.g., immediately).
- **Purchasing Discounts:** Set up discounts that apply to members of this plan. You can discount all products, specific products, or product categories.
- **Members Area:** Customize what sections (Content, Products, Discounts, Notes) appear in the user's account dashboard.

## Creating the Membership Product
After creating a plan, you must create a WooCommerce product for users to purchase:
1. Create a new **WooCommerce product** and set its price.
2. In the **Product Data** section, go to the **Memberships** tab.
3. Under **Grant access upon purchase**, select the membership plan this product should grant access to.
4. Optionally, under **Restrict product**, you can require another membership to purchase this one, creating a tiered system.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Always mark membership products as `Virtual`**. This prevents the system from asking for shipping information during checkout, creating a smoother user experience.

> [!TIP]
> When setting up **Purchasing Discounts** within a membership plan, ensure the discount rule is marked as **`Active`**. If it's not checked, the discount will not be applied to the member's cart.

## The Member Experience
- After purchasing a membership, users gain immediate access to their benefits.
- A dedicated **Members Area** is added to their "My Account" page.
- In this area, they can view:
    - **Content:** A list of restricted content they can now access.
    - **Discounts:** A summary of the purchasing discounts available to them.
    - **Manage:** Options to view their membership status, cancel it, or manually renew it if it has an expiration date.

## Regarding Automatic Renewals
> [!NOTE]
> The WooCommerce Memberships plugin **does not handle automatic recurring payments** on its own. For auto-renewing subscriptions, you must use it in conjunction with the separate **WooCommerce Subscriptions** plugin.
